description: Returns paste-ready HTML (a div plus one script tag) that adds the free face shape finder to a web page at the chosen size, with the usage terms and the embed page URL. The widget measures the visitor's photo in their browser, no sign-up and no upload to this server; the terms ask for the visible credit link to stay. Use this when a website owner wants photo measurement on their page; for one person's own photo, point them to thefaceanalysis.com/face-shape-detector instead (this server accepts no photos), and use classify_face_shape when you already have the four distances. Read-only; it only generates text.

size.description: Widget width: compact (360px), standard (480px) or wide (720px). Default standard.

name: get_embed_snippet
title: Embed code for the face shape widget
